title: INSPECTION PROCEDURE

INSPECTION PROCEDURE

1 Check voltage between terminals VF1 and E1 of data link connector .

VF1

P (1) Warm up engine to normal operating temperature.
(2) Connect terminals TE1 and E1 of data link connector 1.
(3) Connect positive probe to terminal VF1 and negative probe to terminal E1 of data link connector 1.

C (1) warm up the oxygen sensor by racing engine at 2,500 rpm for about 2 minutes.
(2) Then, still maintaining engine at 2,500 rpm, count how many times voltmeter fluctuates need between 0 and 5 V.
